hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in ansible/*.yml|ansible/*.yaml) echo "[ansible syntax-check] $f"; ansible-playbook --syntax-check ansible/playbook-brla.yml -i ansible/inventory/hosts.ini 2>&1 | tail -5;; opentofu/*.tf) echo "[tofu fmt] $f"; tofu fmt -check "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5;; esac
